correctness.rationale: For Haar real rank-k projectors, conjugation invariance gives the quartic trace basis. The beta law for one projector diagonal and the exact conditional two-row moment formula give two linearly independent exact fourth-moment witnesses; SymPy reconstructs the rational coefficients H and B for arbitrary symbolic n,k. The variance comes from irreducible tracefree symmetric O(n) representation. The three-root Lagrange equation plus the zero-sum triple rotation rules out three-level extrema for n>=4, proving both endpoint spectra, including all equality cases. Rank-one and central-rank signs follow from exact factorization and inequalities. Averaging Euclidean comparison quadratic forms over O(n) proves the optimal Banach-Mazur ratio; the n=2,3 exceptions follow from tr(A^4)=tr(A^2)^2/2. The standalone checker reconstructs these identities, with 110,000 sampling diagnostics explicitly not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The full real Grassmannian linear-observable L4 norm and all equality spectra are natural finite-dimensional invariants. For every dimension at least four, rank one and central rank exhibit different extremizer geometry: one-outlier versus balanced eigenspaces reverse maximizing/minimizing status. This rank-sensitive sharp boundary is not just a numerical restatement of an integration formula and remains nontrivial even knowing the general moments. Compact orthogonal symmetry also determines exact Banach–Mazur distance and all intermediate values. No general higher-moment extension is needed for its standalone significance.
